why: AYC 418 shows 900 kg total load with 620 kg must‑ride pharma, leaving only 280 kg free – insufficient for the 780 kg textile shipment (get_capacity: "AYC 418 · 900 kg · 1 PMC · pharma 620 kg must-ride").
Rebooking on AYC 220 provides 3,200 kg free capacity, protects the must‑ride pharma, results in Low risk, +14 h delay and CHF 0 cost (find_alternatives option "next").
Splitting the shipment would fly 280 kg today and the rest tomorrow, incurring Medium risk, +14 h delay and +CHF 70 cost (find_alternatives option "split").
